# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readxl)
  library(rtracklayer)
  library(liftOver)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION", "data")
reference_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data", "ref_files")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "code", "R")

source(file.path(code_dir, "annotation_functions.R"))
```

# Define Functions

## Load Data

```{r func_load}
load_probes <- function() {
  save_name <- file.path(
    save_dir,
    "linear_model",
    "EAP_stats_bacon_interact.csv"
  )
  cpg_df <- read.csv(file = save_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "CpG",
      chr = "Chr",
      position = "Position",
      "GREAT_annotation",
      "Relation_to_Island"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Relation_to_Island = filter_column(.data$Relation_to_Island)
    )

  cpg_df
}

get_signif_probes <- function(cpg_df) {
  read_name <- file.path(
    save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", "interact_mQTLs_inputs.csv"
  )
  sig_df <- read.csv(read_name) %>%
    dplyr::rename(CpG = "cpgs") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(cpg_df, by = "CpG")

  sig_df
}
```

## Load eQTM Results

```{r func_eqtm}
get_eqtm_types <- function() {
  col_types <- c(
    "text",
    "text",
    "numeric",
    "numeric",
    "numeric",
    "text",
    "numeric",
    "text",
    "numeric",
    "numeric",
    "text"
  )

  col_types
}

convert_hg19_to_hg38 <- function(df) {
  path <- file.path(reference_dir, "hg19ToHg38.over.chain")
  ch <- rtracklayer::import.chain(path)

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(index = dplyr::row_number())

  gr <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "index",
      seqnames = "transcript_chr",
      start = "transcript_start",
      end = "transcript_end"
    ) %>%
    GenomicRanges::makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
      keep.extra.columns = TRUE
    )

  GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(gr) <- "UCSC"
  df_38 <- gr %>%
    rtracklayer::liftOver(ch) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      transcript_chr = "seqnames",
      transcript_start = "start",
      transcript_end = "end"
    )

  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -"transcript_start",
      -"transcript_end",
      -"transcript_chr"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      df_38,
      by = "index",
      relationship = "one-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-"index")

  df
}

read_eqtm_sheet <- function(sheet) {
  fname <- file.path(
    reference_dir,
    "eQTm_FHS_array_ClinicalEpigenetics_13148_2021_1041_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx"
  )

  col_types <- get_eqtm_types()

  eqtm_df <- readxl::read_excel(
    fname,
    sheet = sheet,
    skip = 1,
    col_types = col_types
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "CpG",
      "GeneSymbol",
      transcript_chr = "transcript-chromosome",
      transcript_start = "transcript-start",
      transcript_end = "transcript-end",
      T_value = "T value",
      "log10P"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      transcript_chr = paste0("chr", .data$transcript_chr)
    )

  eqtm_df <- convert_hg19_to_hg38(eqtm_df)

  eqtm_df
}
```

## Find Overlaps

```{r func_overlap}
get_overlaps <- function(signif_df, eqtm_df) {
  result_df <- signif_df %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      eqtm_df,
      by = "CpG",
      relationship = "one-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      "CpG",
      "chr",
      "position",
      "GREAT_annotation",
      "Relation_to_Island",
      "GeneSymbol",
      "transcript_chr",
      "transcript_start",
      "transcript_end",
      "T_value",
      "log10P",
      "Sources"
    )

  result_df
}
```

## Save

```{r func_save}
save_results <- function(cis_df, trans_df) {
  write_dir <- file.path(save_dir, "eQTM_probes")
  write.csv(
    cis_df,
    file = file.path(write_dir, "eQTM_Overlaps_cis.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    trans_df,
    file = file.path(write_dir, "eQTM_Overlaps_trans.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Wrapper Function

```{r func_wrapper}
analysis_wrapper <- function(cpg_df, cis_df, trans_df) {
  sig_df <- get_signif_probes(cpg_df)

  cis_df <- get_overlaps(sig_df, cis_df)
  trans_df <- get_overlaps(sig_df, trans_df)

  save_results(cis_df, trans_df)
}
```

# Run Analysis

## Get Data

```{r load}
cpg_df <- load_probes()
cis_df <- read_eqtm_sheet("Table S2")
trans_df <- read_eqtm_sheet("Table S3")
```

## Analyze

```{r analyze}
analysis_wrapper(cpg_df, cis_df, trans_df)
```
